name: Horrors in the Highland
label: Quest
description: Horrors in the Highland: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.
The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.
Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.

clips.title: Progress
paras: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
